definitions.gloss: eye drops; ophthalmic solution; ophthalmic medicine
definitions.explanation: Liquid medication applied directly to the eyes. The formal medical term for what is colloquially called {目薬|めぐすり}.

examples.japanese: {点眼薬|てんがんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{一日|いちにち}→一日：00942_ichinichi⟧⟦{三回|さんかい}→三回：30448_sankai⟧⟦{使用|しよう}→使用：01637_shiyou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please use the eye drops three times a day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医師|いし}→医師：11851_ishi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{点眼薬|てんがんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れ→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{差|さ}しましょう→差す：17637_sasu⟧。
examples.english: Don't forget to apply the eye drops prescribed by the doctor.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦アレルギー→アレルギー：04645_arerugii⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点眼薬|てんがんやく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: When hay fever season arrives, allergy eye drops sell well at pharmacies.

notes:
Compound of {点眼|てんがん} ('instilling drops in the eye') and {薬|やく} ('medicine'). The formal pharmaceutical and medical term for eye drops. In everyday conversation, ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧ is far more common.

USAGE:
- Used on product packaging, in medical instructions, and by healthcare professionals
- Patients speaking with doctors may hear this term, but would typically say ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧ themselves
- The verb for applying eye drops is ⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ or {点眼|てんがん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {点眼薬|てんがんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧: to apply eye drops
- {点眼薬|てんがんやく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{処方|しょほう}→処方：05976_shohou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to prescribe eye drops
- ⟦{抗菌|こうきん}→抗菌：21567_koukin⟧{点眼薬|てんがんやく}: antibacterial eye drops
- ⟦{市販|しはん}→市販：12424_shihan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{点眼薬|てんがんやく}: over-the-counter eye drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧: eye drops — the everyday word, used in casual conversation
- ⟦{外用薬|がいようやく}→外用薬：24270_gaiyouyaku⟧: external medicine — any medication applied to the body's surface, not taken internally
- {点鼻薬|てんびやく}: nasal drops — analogous compound for nose medication
